index.html.title: 巴厘岛北库塔银饰制作体验 | Bali Jewelry Masterclass
index.html.description: 在 Dalung, North Kuta 的 Bali Jewelry Masterclass，跟随导师亲手制作纯银戒指或手镯。工作室距 Canggu 约 10 分钟。

replacements.from: >Bali Jewelry Workshop in North Kuta | Bali Jewelry Masterclass<
replacements.to: >巴厘岛北库塔银饰制作体验 | Bali Jewelry Masterclass<
>你的银饰创作之旅，从这里开始。<

replacements.from: >Turn silver into a ring or piece of jewelry you can truly call your own. Choose your design, work with the tools, and learn the basic techniques with guidance from our instructors.<
replacements.to: >将银材做成一枚戒指或一件真正属于你的首饰。选择设计，亲手使用工具，在导师的指导下学习基本制作技巧。<

replacements.from: >No previous experience needed. Just bring your curiosity and a willingness to try.<
replacements.to: >无需任何经验，只需带着好奇心和尝试的意愿。<
>在巴厘岛家庭的温暖氛围中<

replacements.from: >Bali Jewelry Masterclass is a hands-on silver jewelry workshop held in our local home studio — a personal place to slow down during your time in Bali, learn the craft of jewelry making, and create something of your own.<
replacements.to: >Bali Jewelry Masterclass 是在我们当地的家庭工作室开展的银饰手作体验 — 在巴厘岛旅行期间，你可以在这里放慢脚步，学习首饰制作，亲手创作属于自己的作品。<

replacements.from: >Jewelry is much more interesting when you actually get to make it yourself.<
replacements.to: >亲手制作，让首饰变得更有意思。<

replacements.from: >At Bali Jewelry Masterclass, you’ll work directly with silver and experience the different stages of jewelry making, from choosing your design and melting and rolling the silver to shaping, soldering, filing, and polishing the finished piece.<
replacements.to: >在 Bali Jewelry Masterclass，你会直接接触银材，体验首饰制作的不同环节：从选择设计、熔化和压延银材，到成形、焊接、锉修，再到抛光成品。<

replacements.from: >Our instructors will be there throughout the class to show you how to use the tools and help whenever a step requires more technical skill or control. Once that part is done, the piece goes back to you so you can keep working on it.<
replacements.to: >导师会全程陪伴，示范工具的用法，并在需要更高技巧或更精细操作的步骤提供帮助。完成这部分后，作品会交还给你，让你继续制作。<

replacements.from: >No previous jewelry-making experience is required. Most of our guests are trying it for the first time.<
replacements.to: >无需首饰制作经验，我们的大多数客人都是第一次尝试。<

replacements.from: >You can start with one of our available designs, then adjust the size, shape, texture, and finishing details to make it your own. Engraving or stamped letters and numbers may also be possible with certain designs, depending on the materials and time required.<
replacements.to: >你可以从现有设计中选择一款，再调整尺寸、形状、纹理和表面细节，让它更有自己的特色。某些设计也可能支持刻字，或压印字母和数字，具体取决于材料和所需时间。<

replacements.from: >At the end of the class, your jewelry will be finished and ready to take home.<
replacements.to: >课程结束时，你的首饰将制作完成，可以带回家。<

replacements.from: >Made by you, with a little help from us.<
replacements.to: >由你亲手完成，我们帮一点小忙。<

replacements.from: >The making is part of the meaning.<
replacements.to: >制作过程，也是作品意义的一部分。<

replacements.from: >Discover the materials and steps behind creating your own silver jewelry.<
replacements.to: >了解亲手制作银饰所用的材料和步骤。<

replacements.from: >Our workshop is open every day from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM. For evening sessions, please arrive by 7:00 PM at the latest.<
replacements.to: >工作室每天 10:00 AM 至 9:00 PM 开放。参加晚间课程，请最晚于 7:00 PM 到达。<

replacements.from: >We had such a great experience here! We made our own ring from start to finish — beginning with melting the metal ourselves and finishing with polishing the ring.<
replacements.to: >我们在这里度过了一段很棒的时光！从亲手熔化金属，到最后抛光戒指，我们从头到尾制作了自己的戒指。<

replacements.from: >Met RDNA at a local surfcamp and bonded over music and dreams. Discovered and visited his Shiku Silver Studio and attended a ring making class.<
replacements.to: >在当地冲浪营认识了 RDNA，因为音乐和梦想聊得很投缘。后来了解到他的 Shiku Silver Studio，去参观并参加了戒指制作课。<

replacements.from: >Made one of my favorite rings here. Didn’t take too long to make and everyone was very helpful. Thanks to them I finally made my own wave ring which is very stylish and easy to match with different outfit.<
replacements.to: >我在这里做了一枚自己最喜欢的戒指。制作没花太久，大家都很乐意帮忙。多亏他们，我终于做出了自己的波浪戒指，很有型，也很容易搭配不同的衣服。<

replacements.from: >I really enjoyed making a ring, they were super patient and friendly and helped us with all the steps we couldn’t complete on their own.<
replacements.to: >我很享受制作戒指的过程。他们非常耐心、友好，帮我们完成了无法独立完成的步骤。<

replacements.from: >Yes. Our instructors guide you through each step.<
replacements.to: >适合。导师会逐步指导你完成制作。<

replacements.from: >Yes. You can take your finished piece home the same day.<
replacements.to: >可以，当天就能带走你完成的作品。<

about.html.title: 关于我们 | Bali Jewelry Masterclass
about.html.description: 了解 Bali Jewelry Masterclass 的故事、巴厘岛家庭工作室和教学方式，在本地首饰匠人的指导下，亲手制作自己的银饰。

replacements.from: >A jewelry-making workshop in a home studio in Bali.<
replacements.to: >在巴厘岛家庭工作室体验首饰制作。<

replacements.from: >Classes take place in our home studio in Dalung, North Kuta. This is where we make jewelry and teach our guests using the same tools and techniques we work with ourselves.<
replacements.to: >课程在我们位于 Dalung, North Kuta 的家庭工作室进行。我们在这里制作首饰，也用日常工作中使用的工具和技法指导客人。<

replacements.from: >The atmosphere is relaxed and informal. You can take your time, try things for yourself, and learn as you go.<
replacements.to: >这里氛围轻松、不拘束。你可以慢慢来，亲自尝试，边做边学。<

replacements.from: >From making jewelry for businesses to teaching it at our workbench.<
replacements.to: >从为商家制作首饰，到在工作台前教人制作。<

replacements.from: >Our work began with producing jewelry for businesses and stores in different countries. Over the years, that meant spending countless hours at the workbench, learning the materials, tools, and techniques through everyday production.<
replacements.to: >我们最初为不同国家的商家和店铺制作首饰。多年来，我们在工作台前投入了无数时间，在日常制作中逐渐熟悉材料、工具和技法。<

replacements.from: >That idea became the workshop we run today.<
replacements.to: >这个想法成为了今天的制作体验。<

replacements.from: >You don’t need to know anything about jewelry making before you arrive.<
replacements.to: >来之前，你不需要了解首饰制作。<

replacements.from: >We’ll guide you. You’ll do the making.<
>A small place to learn and make something of your own.<
replacements.to: >一个可以学习、亲手制作自己作品的小空间。<

replacements.from: >Our home studio sits within a local Balinese neighborhood in Dalung. It’s a working space rather than a formal classroom, which helps keep the experience personal and relaxed.<
replacements.to: >我们的家庭工作室位于 Dalung 的巴厘岛本地社区。这是一个实际工作的空间，而非正式教室，让体验更加亲切、轻松。<

replacements.from: >At one workbench, someone might be making their first ring. At another, someone might still be working on the shape or texture of a bracelet.<
replacements.to: >在一张工作台前，有人可能正在制作自己的第一枚戒指；在另一张台前，有人可能还在调整手镯的形状或纹理。<

replacements.from: >There’s no need to rush. Take your time, ask for help when you need it, and enjoy learning something new.<
replacements.to: >不必赶时间。慢慢来，需要时寻求帮助，享受学习新事物的过程。<

replacements.from: >During the class, your instructor will show you how to use the tools and explain each stage before you try it.<
replacements.to: >课程中，导师会先示范工具用法，并在你尝试之前解释每个步骤。<

replacements.from: >Depending on the design you choose, you may work with techniques such as melting, rolling, hammering, shaping, soldering, filing, and polishing silver.<
replacements.to: >根据所选设计，你可能会体验熔化、压延、锤打、成形、焊接、锉修和抛光银材等技法。<

replacements.from: >Some stages require more precision or experience. When they do, your instructor will step in where needed to keep things safe and help you achieve the design you’re working toward.<
replacements.to: >有些步骤需要更高的精确度或经验。此时，导师会在必要时协助或接手，保障安全，并帮助你实现所选设计。<

replacements.from: >Whenever possible, the tools stay in your hands.<
replacements.to: >只要条件允许，工具就由你亲手操作。<

replacements.from: >Most of our guests have never made jewelry before.<
replacements.to: >我们的大多数客人此前都没有制作过首饰。<

replacements.from: >Some arrive with a reference image and know exactly what they want to make. Others decide after looking through the jewelry samples in our studio.<
replacements.to: >有些人带着参考图片而来，清楚自己想做什么；有些人则看过工作室的首饰样品后再决定。<

replacements.from: >Your instructor will help you choose a design that works with the available materials, class time, and level of difficulty, then guide you as you make it.<
replacements.to: >导师会帮你选择适合现有材料、课程时间和难度的设计，再指导你完成制作。<

replacements.from: >The goal is simple: to leave with jewelry you enjoy wearing and a better understanding of how it was made.<
replacements.to: >目标很简单：带走一件你愿意佩戴的首饰，并更了解它是如何制作出来的。<

replacements.from: >Local jewelry makers who enjoy sharing their skills.<
replacements.to: >乐于分享技艺的本地首饰匠人。<

replacements.from: >Our instructors are experienced jewelry makers who have spent years working hands-on with silver at the workbench.<
replacements.to: >我们的导师都是经验丰富的首饰匠人，多年来一直在工作台前亲手加工银材。<

replacements.from: >Making jewelry is one skill. Helping someone make their first piece is another.<
replacements.to: >会制作首饰是一种能力，帮助别人完成第一件作品则是另一种能力。<

replacements.from: >That’s why our approach is practical: demonstrate a technique when needed, lend a hand when something gets difficult, and give you room to continue on your own when you’re ready.<
replacements.to: >因此，我们注重实际操作：需要时示范技法，遇到困难时帮一把，等你准备好后，再给你继续独立制作的空间。<

replacements.from: >And yes, you can ask as many questions as you like.<
>At the end of the class, you’ll leave with the silver jewelry you made that day.<
replacements.to: >课程结束时，你会带走当天亲手制作的银饰。<

replacements.from: >Look closely and you may see details that came directly from the way you worked — the texture left by a hammer, a curve you shaped, or a finishing choice you made along the way.<
replacements.to: >仔细看看，可能会发现一些直接来自你操作的细节：锤子留下的纹理、你塑造的弧度，或你在制作中选择的表面效果。<

replacements.from: >That’s part of the character of something handmade.<
replacements.to: >这就是手工作品的特色之一。<

replacements.from: >And when someone asks where your ring or bracelet came from, you’ll have a pretty simple answer:<
replacements.to: >当有人问你的戒指或手镯是从哪里来的，你可以给出一个很简单的回答：<

replacements.from: >Keep it personal. Keep it honest. Keep making.<
replacements.to: >保持亲切，保持真诚，继续制作。<

replacements.from: >We don’t believe a meaningful experience needs to be complicated.<
replacements.to: >我们不认为有意义的体验一定要复杂。<

replacements.from: >Good materials. Real tools. Patient guidance. A comfortable place to work. And enough freedom to make the piece your own.<
replacements.to: >合适的材料、真实的工具、耐心的指导、舒适的操作空间，以及足够的创作自由，让作品真正属于你。<

replacements.from: >A place where craftsmanship is shared openly.<
replacements.to: >一个愿意坦诚分享工艺的地方。<

replacements.from: >Where people are welcomed as learners, not simply as customers passing through.<
replacements.to: >在这里，大家被当作学习者欢迎，而不仅仅是匆匆路过的顾客。<

replacements.from: >And where a simple piece of silver can become something far more personal because of the hands, time, and story behind it.<
replacements.to: >一块简单的银材，可以因为亲手投入的时间和故事，变得更有个人意义。<

replacements.from: >A PIECE CRAFTED IN BALI, MADE BY YOU.<
>Come with an idea, or come without one.<
replacements.to: >带着想法来，或没有想法也可以。<

skills-techniques.html.sourceTitle: Jewelry-Making Skills & Techniques | Bali Jewelry Masterclass
skills-techniques.html.title: 首饰制作工艺与技巧 | Bali Jewelry Masterclass
skills-techniques.html.description: 了解银材、工具和制作步骤，从选择设计、熔化和压延，到成形、焊接、锉修和抛光，探索亲手制作银饰的过程。

replacements.from: >See the materials, tools, and techniques that turn silver into finished jewelry.<
replacements.to: >了解将银材变成成品首饰的材料、工具和技法。<

replacements.from: >The standard class includes up to 6 grams of pure silver for your jewelry.<
replacements.to: >标准课程包含最多 6 克纯银，用于制作你的首饰。<

replacements.from: >Before you begin, your instructor will help you choose a design and determine how much silver it requires.<
replacements.to: >开始前，导师会帮你选择设计，并确定所需银材用量。<

replacements.from: >From there, you’ll see the material go through each stage of the process until it becomes your finished piece.<
replacements.to: >之后，你会看到材料经历各个步骤，最终成为你的成品。<

replacements.from: >Every design is a little different, but these are the main stages you may encounter during the class.<
replacements.to: >每款设计都有所不同，以下是课程中可能会经历的主要步骤。<

replacements.from: >Your instructor will show you how to use the tools and stay close during stages that involve high heat or require more technical control.<
replacements.to: >导师会示范工具用法，并在涉及高温或需要更精细操作的步骤陪伴在旁。<

replacements.from: >Look through the jewelry samples available in the studio and choose a design you’d like to make.<
replacements.to: >浏览工作室的首饰样品，选择你想制作的设计。<

replacements.from: >Your instructor will help you consider the size, shape, texture, and details that can realistically be completed during the class.<
replacements.to: >导师会帮你考虑课程中能够实际完成的尺寸、形状、纹理和细节。<

replacements.from: >The silver is weighed on a jewelry scale according to the amount needed for your chosen design.<
replacements.to: >根据所选设计的用量，用首饰秤称量银材。<

replacements.from: >Your measurements are also taken so the finished piece can be shaped to the right size and fit.<
replacements.to: >同时测量你的尺寸，让成品能塑造成合适的大小和佩戴效果。<

replacements.from: >The silver is heated until it melts completely.<
>Once molten, it is poured into an ingot mold, where it cools and solidifies into a form that can be worked further.<
replacements.to: >熔化后，将银液倒入银锭模具，冷却凝固成可进一步加工的形态。<

replacements.from: >Because this stage involves very high heat, your instructor will guide you through it and step in whenever necessary.<
replacements.to: >由于这个步骤涉及很高的温度，导师会全程指导，并在必要时接手。<

replacements.from: >The solid silver is gradually worked down using a rolling mill and hammer until it reaches the dimensions needed for your design.<
replacements.to: >用压延机和锤子逐步加工固态银材，直到达到设计所需的尺寸。<

replacements.from: >It may be heated and rolled again along the way if further adjustment is needed.<
replacements.to: >如需进一步调整，过程中可能会再次加热和压延。<

replacements.from: >Once the silver reaches the right dimensions, you’ll begin shaping it into the form of your jewelry.<
replacements.to: >银材达到合适尺寸后，你会开始将它塑造成首饰的形状。<

replacements.from: >Measurements are checked again as you work so the piece can be adjusted to the intended size and fit.<
replacements.to: >制作过程中会再次核对尺寸，以便调整到预定的大小和佩戴效果。<

replacements.from: >Soldering joins the parts of your jewelry that need to be connected.<
replacements.to: >焊接用于连接首饰中需要接合的部分。<

replacements.from: >Because this stage requires more control, your instructor will stay close and help whenever necessary.<
replacements.to: >这个步骤需要更精细的操作，导师会在旁陪伴，并在需要时提供帮助。<

replacements.from: >Once the main form is complete, filing removes rough or uneven areas and helps refine the shape.<
replacements.to: >完成主要形状后，用锉刀去除粗糙或不平整的部位，进一步修整外形。<

replacements.from: >Small adjustments here can make a noticeable difference to how the finished jewelry looks and feels.<
replacements.to: >这里的小调整，可以明显影响成品首饰的外观和触感。<

replacements.from: >The surface is refined and polished to bring out the silver’s natural shine.<
replacements.to: >修整和抛光表面，展现银材的自然光泽。<

replacements.from: >Finally, the size, fit, surface, and small details are checked before your jewelry is ready to wear and take home.<
replacements.to: >最后，检查尺寸、佩戴效果、表面和细节，首饰便可佩戴并带回家。<

replacements.from: >Around two hours later, you leave with jewelry that didn’t exist before.<
replacements.to: >大约两小时后，你带走一件此前并不存在的首饰。<

replacements.from: >You’ll get the same hands-on workshop experience, with guidance from our instructor whenever you need it.<
replacements.to: >你会获得同样的动手制作体验，需要时导师会提供指导。<

replacements.from: >Choose your design, learn the process, and make a piece of silver jewelry of your own.<
replacements.to: >选择设计，学习制作过程，亲手完成一件自己的银饰。<

replacements.from: >Come with your partner, your best friend, or someone you’d simply like to share the workshop with.<

replacements.from: >You’ll each make your own piece of silver jewelry while working side by side through the process.<

replacements.from: >Everyone makes their own piece while our instructors guide the group through the process. You’ll work alongside each other, share ideas, and learn the same jewelry-making techniques together.<

replacements.from: >Traveling together, celebrating something, or looking for an activity everyone can take part in? We can welcome groups of up to 20 guests while keeping the workshop hands-on and guided.<
replacements.to: >一起旅行、庆祝某件事，或寻找每个人都能参与的活动？我们可接待最多 20 位客人的团体，同时保留亲手操作和导师指导。<

replacements.from: >Each guest makes their own piece of jewelry with support from our instructors throughout the workshop.<
replacements.to: >每位客人都会在导师全程支持下制作自己的首饰。<

replacements.from: >Everything you need to make your piece.<

replacements.to: >无需自带工具、材料或首饰制作经验。我们准备好操作空间，从选择设计到完成首饰，全程指导你。<

replacements.from: >A silver material allowance is included for each guest.<

replacements.from: >Choose one jewelry design from our workshop catalog, make it during the workshop, and take it home with you.<
replacements.to: >从工作室设计目录中选择一款首饰，在课程中制作完成，再带回家。<

replacements.from: >The standard workshop includes two hours to make and finish your jewelry.<

replacements.to: >标准课程所需的工具和设备均由我们提供。<

replacements.from: >Our instructors guide you through each stage and assist with techniques that require extra care.<
replacements.to: >导师会指导每个步骤，并协助完成需要格外小心的技法。<

replacements.from: >The workshop is designed for complete beginners. You’ll learn as you make.<
replacements.to: >课程适合完全没有经验的新手，可以边做边学。<

replacements.from: >Your design can go beyond the standard workshop.<
replacements.to: >你的设计可以超出标准课程范围。<

replacements.from: >Want something heavier, more detailed, or a little different from the standard design? Depending on the piece, we may be able to accommodate additional silver, gemstones, custom work, plating, or other details.<
replacements.to: >想做得更重、细节更多，或与标准设计稍有不同？根据具体作品，我们可能可以安排额外银材、宝石、定制加工、镀层或其他细节。<

replacements.from: >Additional silver beyond the included 6 grams is charged per gram.<
replacements.to: >超过所含 6 克额度的银材按克收费。<

replacements.from: >Gemstones, custom work, plating, and other special additions may involve an additional cost depending on the materials, design, and work required.<
replacements.to: >宝石、定制加工、镀层和其他特殊加项可能产生额外费用，取决于材料、设计和所需工作。<

replacements.from: >If your piece needs more than the standard two hours to complete, additional workshop time is available in 30-minute increments.<

policies.html.title: 条款与政策 | Bali Jewelry Masterclass
policies.html.description: 了解 Bali Jewelry Masterclass 的预约、付款、银材额度、安全和年龄要求，以及取消、退款和隐私政策。

replacements.to: >条款与条件 · 取消与退款 · 隐私政策<

replacements.from: >A reservation is confirmed once Bali Jewelry Masterclass has confirmed the workshop date, time, and number of guests.<
replacements.to: >Bali Jewelry Masterclass 确认课程日期、时间和参加人数后，预约才正式确认。<

replacements.from: >Regular bookings may be confirmed without a deposit. For larger groups, special arrangements, or certain bookings, we may request a deposit or advance payment to secure the reservation.<
replacements.to: >常规预约可能无需支付订金即可确认。对于较大团体、特殊安排或某些预约，我们可能要求支付订金或预付款以保留预约。<

replacements.from: >The workshop price confirmed at the time of booking will be honored for that reservation, even if our published prices change afterward.<
replacements.to: >预约时确认的课程价格将适用于该预约，即使之后公布的价格有所变化。<

replacements.from: >For regular bookings, payment is made at the end of the workshop so that any agreed additional materials, add-ons, or extra workshop time can be included in the final amount.<
replacements.to: >常规预约在课程结束时付款，以便将事先同意的额外材料、加项或额外课程时间计入最终金额。<

replacements.from: >Available payment methods will be communicated at the workshop.<
replacements.to: >可用的付款方式将在课程现场说明。<

replacements.from: >Each standard workshop includes up to 6 grams of silver per guest.<
replacements.to: >每位客人的标准课程包含最多 6 克银材。<

replacements.from: >The amount of silver required depends on the jewelry design, dimensions, ring size, and making process. The included 6 grams is a material allowance and does not guarantee that every design or size can be made within 6 grams.<
replacements.to: >银材用量取决于首饰设计、尺寸、戒指大小和制作过程。所含 6 克为材料额度，并不保证所有设计或尺寸都能在 6 克内完成。<

replacements.from: >If your chosen piece is estimated to require more than 6 grams, additional silver is charged at IDR 95,000 per gram.<
replacements.to: >若预计所选作品需要超过 6 克银材，额外部分按每克 IDR 95,000 收费。<

replacements.from: >Unused portions of the included silver allowance are not refundable, exchangeable, or provided separately as unused silver.<
replacements.to: >所含银材额度的未使用部分不可退款、兑换，也不会作为未使用银材另行提供。<

replacements.from: >Before the workshop begins, we will review your chosen design, size, estimated silver requirement, and any optional add-ons with you.<
replacements.to: >课程开始前，我们会与你核对所选设计、尺寸、预计银材用量和任何可选加项。<

replacements.from: >If additional silver, gemstones, custom work, or other add-ons are required, the estimated additional cost will be explained before work begins.<
replacements.to: >若需要额外银材、宝石、定制加工或其他加项，预计额外费用将在开始前说明。<

replacements.from: >No additional charge will be added without your prior approval.<
replacements.to: >未经你事先同意，不会加收任何额外费用。<

replacements.from: >Because jewelry is handmade, material requirements are estimates. Some material may be lost or remain as residue during the making process, and the final weight of your finished jewelry may therefore differ from the amount of material initially estimated.<
replacements.to: >由于首饰为手工制作，材料需求属于估算。制作过程中可能有材料损耗或残留，因此成品首饰的最终重量可能与最初估算的材料用量不同。<

replacements.from: >Additional workshop time is charged at IDR 100,000 per hour, calculated in 30-minute increments (IDR 50,000 per additional 30 minutes).<
replacements.to: >额外课程时间按每小时 IDR 100,000 收费，以每 30 分钟为单位计算（每额外 30 分钟 IDR 50,000）。<

replacements.from: >Where a chosen design or customization is expected to require additional time, we will explain this before the workshop begins whenever reasonably possible.<
replacements.to: >若预计所选设计或定制需求需要额外时间，我们会在合理可行的情况下于课程开始前说明。<

replacements.from: >Additional time caused by delays or operational issues on our side will not be charged to the guest.<
replacements.to: >因我们一方的延误或操作问题产生的额外时间，不向客人收费。<

replacements.from: >Your jewelry is handmade by you with guidance from our instructors.<
replacements.to: >你将在导师指导下亲手制作首饰。<

replacements.from: >Our sample pieces and catalog designs are references. Because every piece is made by hand, your finished jewelry may not be 100% identical to a sample.<
replacements.to: >样品和目录设计仅供参考。由于每件作品均为手工制作，成品可能不会与样品 100% 相同。<

replacements.from: >Small variations in shape, dimensions, texture, finishing, details, and overall appearance are a natural part of the handmade process.<
replacements.to: >形状、尺寸、纹理、表面处理、细节和整体外观的细微差异，是手工制作过程的自然结果。<

replacements.from: >Our instructors will guide you toward the agreed design while preserving the hands-on nature of the experience.<
replacements.to: >导师会指导你朝着约定的设计完成作品，同时保留亲手操作的体验。<

replacements.from: >Jewelry making involves tools, heat, flame, machinery, and other equipment that must be used carefully.<
replacements.to: >首饰制作涉及工具、高温、明火、机械和其他设备，必须谨慎使用。<

replacements.from: >Guests must follow instructor guidance and safety instructions throughout the workshop.<
replacements.to: >客人须在整个课程中遵循导师指导和安全要求。<

replacements.from: >Our instructors may assist with or take over a particular step if they believe it would be safer to do so.<
replacements.to: >如果导师认为这样更安全，可能会协助或接手某个步骤。<

replacements.from: >If a guest repeatedly ignores safety instructions or behaves in a way that may endanger themselves, other guests, our team, or the workshop environment, Bali Jewelry Masterclass reserves the right to stop that guest's participation.<
replacements.to: >若客人反复忽视安全指示，或其行为可能危及自己、其他客人、团队或工作室环境，Bali Jewelry Masterclass 保留终止该客人参与课程的权利。<

replacements.from: >The minimum age to participate in the workshop is 12 years old.<
replacements.to: >参加课程的最低年龄为 12 岁。<

replacements.from: >Guests aged 12–17 must be accompanied by a parent or responsible guardian during the workshop.<
replacements.to: >12–17 岁客人须由家长或负责的监护人全程陪同。<

replacements.from: >For younger participants, instructors may modify, assist with, or take over particular steps depending on the participant's ability and the safety requirements of the process.<
replacements.to: >对于年龄较小的参与者，导师可能根据其能力和相关工序的安全要求，调整、协助或接手某些步骤。<

replacements.from: >Once your finished jewelry has been completed and taken home, subsequent repairs, resizing, refinishing, or other modifications may incur an additional repair or service charge.<
replacements.to: >首饰完成并带回家后，后续维修、调整尺寸、重新处理表面或其他修改可能产生额外维修或服务费用。<

replacements.from: >Any applicable cost will be communicated before repair or modification work begins.<
replacements.to: >任何适用费用将在维修或修改开始前告知。<

replacements.from: >If you need to cancel your workshop, please let us know at least 12 hours before your scheduled workshop time.<
replacements.to: >如需取消课程，请至少在预约开始时间前 12 小时通知我们。<

replacements.from: >Bookings may be rescheduled up to 3 times, subject to availability.<
replacements.to: >预约最多可更改 3 次，须视空位情况而定。<

replacements.from: >We will do our best to accommodate your preferred new date or time, but availability cannot be guaranteed.<
replacements.to: >我们会尽力安排你希望的新日期或时间，但无法保证一定有空位。<

replacements.from: >If you arrive late, we will try to accommodate you where possible.<
replacements.to: >若你迟到，我们会在条件允许时尽量安排。<

replacements.from: >If your late arrival means there is not enough time to complete the workshop before a fully booked following session, your workshop may need to be rescheduled.<
replacements.to: >若迟到导致无法在下一场已满员的课程前完成，你的课程可能需要改期。<

replacements.from: >If space is available in a later session, we may offer you a place in that session, subject to availability.<
replacements.to: >若之后的场次有空位，我们可能为你安排该场次，须视实际空位情况而定。<

replacements.from: >For reservations made without advance payment, there is no payment to refund in the event of a no-show.<
replacements.to: >对于未预先付款的预约，未到场时没有款项可供退还。<

replacements.from: >Guests who do not attend a confirmed booking without notifying us may be required to provide a deposit or advance payment for a future reservation.<
replacements.to: >如未通知我们便缺席已确认的预约，今后的预约可能需要支付订金或预付款。<

replacements.from: >In the unlikely event that we need to cancel your workshop, we will offer an alternative date or time.<
replacements.to: >如遇少见情况，需要由我们取消课程，我们会提供其他日期或时间。<

replacements.from: >If you have already made a payment and cannot or do not wish to reschedule, the amount paid for the cancelled workshop will be refunded in full.<
replacements.to: >若你已付款，但无法或不希望改期，已取消课程的付款将全额退还。<

replacements.from: >We only collect information reasonably necessary to manage your workshop and communicate with you.<
replacements.to: >我们仅收集管理课程和与你沟通所合理需要的信息。<

replacements.from: >This may include your name, contact details, booking information, workshop preferences, and other information you voluntarily provide to us.<
replacements.to: >这些信息可能包括姓名、联系方式、预约信息、课程偏好，以及你自愿提供的其他信息。<

replacements.from: >We may also ask how you discovered Bali Jewelry Masterclass to help us understand which channels introduce guests to our workshop.<
replacements.to: >我们也可能询问你如何了解到 Bali Jewelry Masterclass，以了解哪些渠道帮助客人找到我们的课程。<

replacements.from: >We may use your information to manage and confirm reservations, communicate with you about your workshop, provide workshop-related services and documentation, process or record transactions, respond to questions, and improve our services.<
replacements.to: >我们可能使用这些信息管理和确认预约、与你沟通课程事宜、提供课程相关服务和记录、处理或记录交易、回答问题，以及改进服务。<

replacements.from: >We do not sell your personal information.<
replacements.to: >我们不会出售你的个人信息。<

replacements.from: >Photos and videos may be taken during the workshop as part of the guest experience and workshop documentation.<
replacements.to: >课程中可能会拍摄照片和视频，作为客人体验和课程记录的一部分。<

replacements.from: >Use of identifiable photos or videos of guests for Bali Jewelry Masterclass marketing — including our website, social media, and promotional materials — is based on optional guest consent.<
replacements.to: >Bali Jewelry Masterclass 将可识别客人身份的照片或视频用于营销（包括网站、社交媒体和宣传材料），须基于客人自愿同意。<

replacements.from: >Choosing not to give marketing consent does not affect your ability to participate in the workshop.<

replacements.from: >If you have previously given consent and later wish to withdraw it, you may contact us. We will stop future use and, where reasonably possible, remove the material from channels under our control.<
replacements.to: >若你曾同意、之后希望撤回，可以联系我们。我们会停止今后的使用，并在合理可行的情况下，从我们控制的渠道移除相关内容。<

replacements.from: >We cannot guarantee removal of copies that have already been independently shared, reposted, cached, or stored by third parties.<

replacements.from: >Our website and communications may use third-party services necessary to operate our website, social media presence, communications, payments, or other business functions.<

replacements.from: >Where personal information is processed by a third-party service, its handling may also be governed by that provider's own privacy policy.<

replacements.from: >We only intend to share information where reasonably necessary to provide our services, operate our business, or comply with applicable legal obligations.<

faq.html.description: 预约前了解银饰制作课程、价格、材料额度、付款、改期、交通、年龄要求与安全指导等常见问题。

replacements.from: >Everything you need to know before joining a Bali Jewelry Masterclass workshop.<
replacements.to: >参加 Bali Jewelry Masterclass 制作体验前，你需要了解的信息。<

replacements.from: >Yes. No previous jewelry-making experience is required. Our instructors guide you through the process step by step.<
replacements.to: >适合。无需首饰制作经验，导师会逐步指导你完成制作。<

replacements.from: >The standard workshop duration is 2 hours. Some designs or customizations may require additional time.<
replacements.to: >标准课程时长为 2 小时，某些设计或定制需求可能需要额外时间。<

replacements.from: >What will I make during the workshop?<
>Our main workshop experience focuses on making your own silver jewelry, with rings as the primary and most popular option. Available designs and other options can be discussed with our team.<
replacements.to: >我们的主要体验是亲手制作银饰，其中戒指是主要且最受欢迎的选择。可选设计和其他方案可以与团队讨论。<

replacements.from: >Yes. This is a hands-on workshop. You will take part in the jewelry-making process with guidance from our instructors. For safety or technical reasons, an instructor may assist with or take over certain steps when necessary.<
replacements.to: >是的，这是动手制作课程。你会在导师指导下参与首饰制作过程。出于安全或技术原因，导师可能在必要时协助或接手某些步骤。<

replacements.from: >Yes. You can choose from BJM sample/catalog designs, and custom ideas may also be possible depending on complexity, material requirements, and available workshop time.<
replacements.to: >可以。你可以从 BJM 样品或设计目录中选择，也可能可以尝试自己的想法，具体取决于复杂程度、材料需求和可用课程时间。<

replacements.from: >Will my finished jewelry look exactly like the sample?<

>Not necessarily. Every piece is handmade, so small variations in shape, dimensions, texture, finishing, details, and overall appearance are a natural part of the process. Our samples are design references rather than exact production templates.<
replacements.to: >不一定。每件作品均为手工制作，因此形状、尺寸、纹理、表面处理、细节和整体外观的细微差异是自然结果。样品是设计参考，而非精确复制的生产模板。<

replacements.from: >Can I take my jewelry home the same day?<
>Yes. You take your finished jewelry home when your workshop is completed, the same day.<
replacements.to: >可以，课程完成当天，你就能带走成品首饰。<

replacements.from: >What is included in the workshop price?<

>The standard workshop includes instructor guidance, the hands-on jewelry-making experience, up to 6 grams of silver material per guest, and one finished piece of jewelry to take home. Optional add-ons, additional silver, special customization, and additional workshop time may cost extra.<
replacements.to: >标准课程包含导师指导、动手制作体验、每位客人最多 6 克银材，以及一件可带回家的成品首饰。可选加项、额外银材、特殊定制和额外课程时间可能另行收费。<

replacements.from: >Up to 6 grams of silver per guest is included in the standard workshop price.<
replacements.to: >标准课程价格包含每位客人最多 6 克银材。<

replacements.from: >The 6 grams is a material allowance, not a guarantee that every design or ring size can be made using 6 grams. The amount required depends on the design, dimensions, ring size, and making process.<
replacements.to: >6 克是材料额度，并不保证所有设计或戒指尺寸都能用 6 克完成。实际用量取决于设计、尺寸、戒指大小和制作过程。<

replacements.from: >What if my design requires more than 6 grams of silver?<
replacements.to: >设计需要超过 6 克银材怎么办？<

replacements.from: >Additional silver is charged at IDR 95,000 per gram.<
replacements.to: >额外银材按每克 IDR 95,000 收费。<

replacements.from: >For example, if your chosen design and size are estimated to require 9 grams, 6 grams are included and the additional 3 grams would cost IDR 300,000.<
replacements.to: >例如，若预计所选设计和尺寸需要 9 克银材，包含的额度为 6 克，额外 3 克费用为 IDR 300,000。<

replacements.from: >The estimated material requirement and additional cost will be explained to you before the workshop begins.<
replacements.to: >预计材料用量和额外费用会在课程开始前向你说明。<

replacements.from: >What happens if my jewelry requires less than 6 grams?<
replacements.to: >如果首饰用不到 6 克怎么办？<

replacements.from: >The included 6 grams is a material allowance rather than a quantity of silver purchased by the guest. Unused allowance is not refundable, exchangeable, or provided separately as unused silver.<
replacements.to: >所含 6 克是材料额度，并非客人购买的银材数量。未使用的额度不可退款、兑换，也不会作为未使用银材另行提供。<

replacements.from: >Some material may also be lost or remain as residue during the handmade jewelry-making process.<
replacements.to: >手工制作过程中，也可能有部分材料损耗或残留。<

replacements.from: >Can I add gemstones or other custom details?<
replacements.to: >可以添加宝石或其他定制细节吗？<

replacements.from: >Depending on the design and availability, gemstones, custom work, or other add-ons may be possible and may involve an additional charge.<
replacements.to: >视设计和供应情况，可能可以加入宝石、定制加工或其他加项，并可能产生额外费用。<

replacements.from: >Any additional cost will be explained before work begins.<
replacements.to: >任何额外费用都会在开始前说明。<

replacements.from: >No additional material, add-on, or customization charge will be added without your prior approval.<
replacements.to: >未经你事先同意，不会加收材料、加项或定制费用。<

replacements.from: >Before starting, we review your chosen design, size, estimated material requirement, and relevant add-ons with you.<
replacements.to: >开始前，我们会与你核对所选设计、尺寸、预计材料用量和相关加项。<

replacements.from: >What if my jewelry takes longer than 2 hours?<
>Additional workshop time is IDR 100,000 per hour, calculated in 30-minute increments at IDR 50,000 per additional 30 minutes.<
replacements.to: >额外课程时间按每小时 IDR 100,000 收费，以每 30 分钟为单位计算，每额外 30 分钟为 IDR 50,000。<

replacements.from: >If a chosen design or customization is expected to require additional time, we will explain this before starting whenever reasonably possible.<
replacements.to: >若预计所选设计或定制需求需要额外时间，我们会在合理可行的情况下于开始前说明。<

replacements.from: >Additional time caused by operational delays on our side is not charged to the guest.<
replacements.to: >因我们一方的运营延误产生的额外时间，不向客人收费。<

replacements.from: >Do I need to book in advance?<
>Advance reservation is recommended so we can prepare your workshop and confirm availability. BJM generally accepts reservations at least one day in advance.<
replacements.to: >建议提前预约，以便我们准备课程并确认空位。BJM 通常接受至少提前一天的预约。<

replacements.from: >Do I need to pay a deposit?<
>Regular bookings may be confirmed without a deposit. For larger groups, special arrangements, or certain bookings, BJM may request a deposit or advance payment to secure the reservation.<
replacements.to: >常规预约可能无需订金即可确认。对于较大团体、特殊安排或某些预约，BJM 可能要求订金或预付款以保留预约。<

replacements.from: >For regular bookings, payment is made at the end of the workshop. This allows any previously agreed additional materials, add-ons, or extra workshop time to be included in the final amount.<
replacements.to: >常规预约在课程结束时付款，以便将事先同意的额外材料、加项或额外课程时间计入最终金额。<

replacements.from: >What price applies if the workshop price changes after I book?<
replacements.to: >预约后课程价格变化，以哪个价格为准？<

replacements.from: >The workshop price confirmed when your reservation is confirmed will be honored for that booking.<
replacements.to: >该预约将按确认预约时确定的课程价格收费。<

replacements.from: >Yes. Please notify us at least 12 hours before your scheduled workshop time if you need to cancel.<
replacements.to: >可以。如需取消，请至少在预约课程开始前 12 小时通知我们。<

replacements.from: >Yes. A booking may be rescheduled up to 3 times, subject to availability.<
replacements.to: >可以，预约最多可更改 3 次，须视空位情况而定。<

replacements.from: >We will try to accommodate you where possible.<
replacements.to: >我们会在条件允许时尽量安排。<

replacements.from: >If there is not enough time to complete your workshop before a fully booked following session, your booking may need to be rescheduled.<
replacements.to: >若无法在下一场已满员的课程前完成你的课程，预约可能需要改期。<

replacements.from: >If space is available in a later session, we may offer you a place in that session, subject to availability.<
replacements.to: >若之后的场次有空位，我们可能为你安排该场次，须视实际空位情况而定。<

replacements.from: >What happens if I don't show up?<
>Guests who do not attend a confirmed booking without notifying us may be required to provide a deposit or advance payment for a future reservation.<
replacements.to: >如未通知我们便缺席已确认的预约，今后的预约可能需要支付订金或预付款。<

replacements.from: >What happens if BJM has to cancel my workshop?<
replacements.to: >如果 BJM 必须取消我的课程会怎样？<

replacements.from: >We will offer an alternative date or time. If you have already paid and cannot or do not wish to reschedule, the payment for the cancelled workshop will be refunded in full.<
replacements.to: >我们会提供其他日期或时间。若你已付款，但无法或不希望改期，已取消课程的付款将全额退还。<

replacements.from: >Bali Jewelry Masterclass is located in Dalung, North Kuta, Bali, Indonesia.<
replacements.to: >Bali Jewelry Masterclass 位于 Dalung, North Kuta, Bali, Indonesia。<

replacements.from: >We are a home studio in a local Balinese neighborhood rather than a resort or large commercial jewelry studio.<
replacements.to: >我们是巴厘岛本地社区中的家庭工作室，而非度假村或大型商业首饰工作室。<

replacements.from: >No. Transportation is not included in the workshop price.<
replacements.to: >不包含，交通不计入课程价格。<

replacements.from: >Guests may arrange their own transportation to our home studio. Optional pickup may be available upon request; please contact BJM for availability and pricing.<
replacements.to: >客人可自行安排前往家庭工作室的交通。按需可能提供接送选项，请联系 BJM 确认是否可安排及价格。<

replacements.from: >How many people can join a workshop?<
>Bali Jewelry Masterclass can accommodate up to 20 guests per session.<
replacements.to: >Bali Jewelry Masterclass 每场最多可接待 20 位客人。<

replacements.from: >For larger bookings or special group arrangements, please contact us in advance so we can confirm availability and prepare appropriately.<
replacements.to: >人数较多或有特殊团体安排时，请提前联系，以便我们确认空位并做好准备。<

replacements.from: >What is the minimum age to join?<
replacements.to: >参加课程的最低年龄是多少？<

replacements.from: >The minimum participant age is 12 years old.<
>Do guests under 18 need a parent or guardian?<
replacements.to: >未满 18 岁需要家长或监护人陪同吗？<

replacements.from: >Yes. Guests aged 12–17 must be accompanied by a parent or responsible guardian during the workshop.<
replacements.to: >需要。12–17 岁客人须由家长或负责的监护人全程陪同。<

replacements.from: >Jewelry making involves tools, heat, flame, machinery, and other equipment.<
replacements.to: >首饰制作涉及工具、高温、明火、机械和其他设备。<

replacements.from: >Our instructors provide guidance throughout the process, and guests must follow all safety instructions. An instructor may assist with or take over a particular step when necessary for safety.<
replacements.to: >导师会全程指导，客人必须遵循所有安全指示。出于安全需要，导师可能协助或接手某个步骤。<

replacements.from: >Can my jewelry be repaired or resized later?<
replacements.to: >之后可以维修或调整尺寸吗？<

replacements.from: >Yes, depending on the jewelry and the work required.<
replacements.to: >可以，具体取决于首饰和所需工作。<

replacements.from: >Repairs, resizing, refinishing, or other modifications requested after the completed jewelry has been taken home may involve an additional repair or service charge.<
replacements.to: >成品首饰带回家后，申请维修、调整尺寸、重新处理表面或其他修改，可能产生额外维修或服务费用。<

replacements.from: >The applicable cost will be explained before any repair or modification work begins.<
replacements.to: >适用费用将在任何维修或修改开始前说明。<

replacements.from: >Do you take photos or videos during the workshop?<
>Photos or videos may be taken during the workshop as part of the guest experience and documentation.<
replacements.to: >课程中可能会拍摄照片或视频，作为客人体验和记录的一部分。<

replacements.from: >Can BJM use my photos for social media or marketing?<
replacements.to: >BJM 可以将我的照片用于社交媒体或营销吗？<

replacements.from: >Permission to use identifiable photos or videos of you for BJM's website, social media, or promotional materials is optional. Choosing not to give marketing consent does not affect your workshop experience.<
replacements.to: >是否允许将可识别你身份的照片或视频用于 BJM 网站、社交媒体或宣传材料，由你自愿决定。不同意营销使用，不影响课程体验。<

replacements.from: >We're happy to help before you book.<
replacements.to: >我们很乐意在你预约前解答。<

what-to-wear-jewelry-making-class-bali.h.sourceDescription: What should you wear to a jewelry-making class in Bali? Learn what clothing, shoes and personal items can make a hands-on silver workshop more comfortable.
what-to-wear-jewelry-making-class-bali.h.title: 巴厘岛首饰制作课穿着指南 | BJM
what-to-wear-jewelry-making-class-bali.h.description: 参加巴厘岛首饰制作课穿什么？了解适合动手银饰课程的衣服、鞋子和随身物品，让制作过程更舒适。

replacements.from: >What Should You Wear to a Jewelry-Making Class in Bali?<
replacements.to: >在巴厘岛参加首饰制作课穿什么？<

replacements.from: >You do not need a special outfit for a jewelry-making class.<
replacements.to: >参加首饰制作课，不需要准备特别的服装。<

replacements.from: >Wear comfortable clothes that let you sit, move, and work easily with your hands.<
replacements.to: >穿舒适的衣服，让你能轻松坐下、活动，也方便双手操作。<

replacements.from: >Jewelry making is hands-on, so you may spend time leaning over a workbench, using tools, shaping metal, filing, polishing, and working around equipment.<
replacements.to: >首饰制作需要亲手操作。你可能会俯身在工作台前，使用工具、给金属成形、锉修、抛光，并在设备周围进行操作。<

replacements.from: >You can still wear something you like—especially if you want photos during the experience.<
replacements.to: >你仍然可以穿自己喜欢的衣服，尤其是想在体验过程中拍照的话。<

replacements.from: >Just choose an outfit you will not spend the whole workshop adjusting or worrying about.<
replacements.to: >只要选择一套不用在整个课程中不断调整、也不用担心弄坏的衣服就好。<

replacements.from: >Choose clothes you can comfortably work in<
>You will probably spend a good part of the workshop sitting at a bench and concentrating on relatively small details.<
replacements.to: >课程中，你很可能有不少时间坐在工作台前，专注处理比较细小的细节。<

replacements.from: >Your position may change as you use different tools or move through <
replacements.to: >你的姿势可能会随着所用工具或 <
>作品的不同制作阶段而变化<

replacements.from: >Ordinary clothes are fine as long as you can move comfortably in them.<
replacements.to: >普通衣服就可以，只要穿着方便活动。<

replacements.from: >If something feels restrictive when you sit, lean forward, or move your arms, it may become annoying after a while.<
replacements.to: >如果坐下、前倾或活动手臂时感觉束缚，时间一长可能会让人不舒服。<

replacements.from: >The best workshop outfit is usually one you can forget about once you start making jewelry.<
replacements.to: >最适合的衣服，往往是让你开始制作首饰后就忘了它的存在的那一套。<

replacements.from: >Very loose sleeves, scarves, or flowing fabric can get in the way when you are working at a bench.<
replacements.to: >在工作台前操作时，过于宽松的袖子、围巾或飘动的布料可能会碍事。<

replacements.from: >That does not mean you need to avoid them completely.<
replacements.to: >这并不意味着完全不能穿这些衣物。<

replacements.from: >It simply helps if loose clothing can be rolled, adjusted, or secured when necessary.<
replacements.to: >只要必要时能卷起、调整或固定好宽松的部分，就会方便一些。<

replacements.from: >Different tools and stages may require different precautions, so follow your instructor's guidance during the session.<
replacements.to: >不同工具和步骤可能有不同的注意事项，因此课程中请听从导师的指导。<

replacements.from: >If they ask you to move or secure something before using a particular piece of equipment, do that before continuing.<
replacements.to: >如果导师请你在使用某件设备前挪开或固定某样东西，请先做好再继续操作。<

replacements.from: >Bring a hair tie if you have long hair<
>Long hair can become distracting when you are leaning over your work.<
replacements.to: >俯身制作时，长发可能会让你分心。<

replacements.from: >There may also be stages where keeping it away from tools, equipment, or the working area is appropriate.<
replacements.to: >某些步骤也可能需要让头发远离工具、设备或操作区域。<

replacements.from: >You do not necessarily need to keep your hair tied back throughout the entire workshop.<
replacements.to: >不一定需要在整个课程中都把头发扎起来。<

replacements.from: >But bringing a hair tie means you can secure it whenever needed.<
replacements.to: >不过带上发圈，需要时就能把头发固定好。<

replacements.from: >It is a tiny thing that is easy to forget until you are already sitting at the bench.<
replacements.to: >这是个很小的细节，却很容易直到坐在工作台前才想起来。<

replacements.from: >You do not need to arrive in professional workshop boots unless the studio you are visiting specifically requires them.<
replacements.to: >除非你要去的工作室明确要求，否则不需要穿专业工作靴。<

replacements.from: >Choose footwear that is comfortable and practical for the workshop and the rest of your day.<
replacements.to: >选择舒适、实用的鞋子，既适合课程，也适合当天其他活动。<

replacements.from: >Because jewelry making involves tools, equipment, and small pieces of material, avoid making assumptions about safety requirements based on what you have seen elsewhere.<
replacements.to: >首饰制作涉及工具、设备和小块材料，不要根据在其他地方见过的做法，自行推断安全要求。<

replacements.from: >Individual workshops may have their own procedures.<
replacements.to: >不同工作室可能有各自的操作规范。<

replacements.from: >If the studio gives you specific footwear instructions, follow those.<
replacements.to: >如果工作室对鞋子有具体要求，请按要求穿着。<

replacements.from: >Otherwise, choose something comfortable that you can move around in easily.<
replacements.to: >如果没有，就选择穿着舒服、方便走动的鞋子。<

replacements.from: >If you bring valuable jewelry, keep in mind that you may need somewhere secure to put it while you work.<

replacements.from: >Keeping accessories relatively simple can make things easier.<

replacements.from: >That does not mean you should expect to leave covered in dirt.<

replacements.from: >Bali can be warm, so lightweight clothing may be comfortable when traveling to and from the workshop.<

replacements.from: >How Much Silver Do You Need to Make a Ring?<
>If a jewelry workshop includes 6 grams of silver, is that enough to make a ring?<
replacements.to: >如果首饰制作课程包含 6 克银材，够做一枚戒指吗？<

replacements.from: >But there is no single number of grams that every ring requires.<
replacements.to: >不过，并不存在一个适用于所有戒指的克数。<

replacements.from: >A narrow band for a smaller finger and a wide, thick ring for a larger finger are physically different objects. Even if both are simply called “silver rings,” they may need very different amounts of material.<
replacements.to: >适合较细手指的窄戒圈，与适合较粗手指的宽厚戒指，在尺寸上是不同的物件。即使都叫“银戒指”，所需材料也可能差很多。<

replacements.from: >The amount of silver you need depends on the dimensions and construction of the ring you actually want to make.<
replacements.to: >需要多少银材，取决于你实际想做的戒指的尺寸和结构。<

replacements.from: >What does a number like 6 grams actually tell you?<
replacements.to: >6 克这样的数字，究竟说明什么？<

what-to-expect-silver-jewelry-making-cla.sourceDescription: Never made jewelry before? Learn what to expect in a silver jewelry-making class in Bali, from choosing a design to shaping, soldering, polishing and taking your piece home.
what-to-expect-silver-jewelry-making-cla.title: 巴厘岛银饰制作课体验指南 | BJM
what-to-expect-silver-jewelry-making-cla.description: 从未做过首饰？了解巴厘岛银饰制作课的体验，从选择设计到成形、焊接、抛光，再把作品带回家。

replacements.from: >What to Expect in a Silver Jewelry-Making Class in Bali:<
replacements.to: >在巴厘岛的银饰制作课上会经历什么：<

replacements.from: >You have booked a silver jewelry-making class in Bali.<
replacements.to: >你已经预约了巴厘岛的银饰制作课。<

replacements.from: >So what actually happens when you arrive?<
>You will not simply choose a finished ring, add a few decorative details, and call it handmade.<
replacements.to: >你并不是简单地挑一枚成品戒指，加几个装饰细节，就把它称为手工作品。<

replacements.from: >In a hands-on workshop, you begin with an idea and follow the material through the stages needed to turn it into jewelry.<
replacements.to: >在动手课程中，你从一个想法开始，经历把材料变成首饰所需的各个步骤。<

replacements.from: >The exact process depends on what you make, but if this is your first time at a jewelry bench, here is a practical idea of what your session may look like.<
replacements.to: >具体过程取决于制作什么。如果这是你第一次坐在首饰工作台前，以下内容可以帮你了解场次中可能发生的事。<

replacements.from: >Your first task is deciding what you want to make.<
>You might arrive with a reference image saved on your phone, or you may choose from designs available at the workshop.<
replacements.to: >你可能已经把参考图存在手机里，也可以从工作室现有设计中选择。<

replacements.from: >Before work begins, the design needs to make sense for the available material, time, and techniques.<
replacements.to: >开始前，设计需要符合可用材料、时间和技法的实际范围。<

replacements.from: >This is when you can discuss things such as:<
>the type of jewelry you want to make<
>any details you would like to add<
>whether additional time or special work may be needed<
replacements.to: >是否可能需要额外时间或特殊加工<

replacements.from: >If your original idea is too complicated for the session, it may be possible to simplify or adapt it while keeping the elements you like most.<
replacements.to: >如果原来的想法对这次场次来说太复杂，也许可以简化或调整，同时保留你最喜欢的元素。<

replacements.from: >Once the design is clear, the actual making can begin.<
replacements.to: >设计确定后，就可以开始动手制作。<

replacements.from: >The amount of silver needed depends on the piece you are making, so the material is weighed before it is worked.<
replacements.to: >所需银材用量取决于制作的作品，因此加工前会先称重。<

replacements.from: >For a ring, your finger size and the intended dimensions of the design also need to be considered.<
replacements.to: >如果做戒指，也需要考虑手指尺寸和设计预期的尺寸。<

replacements.from: >At this point, the silver still looks nothing like the finished jewelry.<
replacements.to: >这时的银材看起来还完全不像成品首饰。<

replacements.from: >For many pieces made at Bali Jewelry Masterclass, the silver is heated until it becomes molten.<
replacements.to: >在 Bali Jewelry Masterclass 制作的许多作品，都会先把银材加热至熔融状态。<

replacements.from: >The molten silver is then poured into an ingot mold.<
replacements.to: >之后将熔化的银倒入银锭模具。<

replacements.from: >As it cools, it solidifies into a workable form that can be developed further.<
replacements.to: >冷却时，它会凝固成可以继续加工的形态。<

replacements.from: >This is one of the stages where instructor involvement is particularly important because of the very high heat involved.<
replacements.to: >由于涉及很高的温度，这个步骤尤其需要导师参与。<

replacements.from: >Your instructor will explain what is happening, guide the process, and step in whenever necessary.<
replacements.to: >导师会解释正在发生什么，引导操作，并在必要时介入。<

replacements.from: >What comes out of the mold is not a ring or a finished jewelry component.<
replacements.to: >从模具里出来的，并不是戒指或已经完成的首饰部件。<

replacements.from: >It is the starting material for the next stages.<
replacements.to: >它是后续步骤所需的初始材料。<

replacements.from: >3. The silver is rolled and worked to size<
replacements.to: >3. 压延并加工至所需尺寸<

replacements.from: >The solid silver now needs to reach the dimensions required for your design.<
replacements.to: >凝固的银材需要达到设计所需的尺寸。<

replacements.from: >A rolling mill can gradually change its thickness and proportions.<
replacements.to: >压延机可以逐步改变它的厚度和比例。<

replacements.from: >Hammering may also be used as the material develops.<
replacements.to: >材料加工过程中，也可能用到锤打。<

replacements.from: >Depending on what the piece needs, the silver may be heated and worked again before reaching the correct dimensions.<
replacements.to: >根据作品需要，银材可能要再次加热、加工，才能达到合适尺寸。<

replacements.from: >This part of the process makes something important very obvious:<
replacements.to: >这个过程会让一件重要的事变得很明显：<

replacements.from: >Jewelry does not suddenly emerge from molten silver in its finished shape.<
replacements.to: >熔化的银并不会突然变成最终形状的首饰。<

replacements.from: >The material has to be worked progressively toward the form you need.<
replacements.to: >材料需要逐步加工，才能成为所需的形态。<

replacements.from: >4. Your jewelry begins to take shape<
>Once the silver reaches suitable dimensions, you can begin developing the actual form of the jewelry.<
replacements.to: >银材达到合适尺寸后，就可以开始制作首饰的实际形状。<

replacements.to: >根据设计，其他首饰可能采用不同的步骤顺序。<

replacements.from: >This is why two guests sitting at the same workbench do not necessarily perform exactly the same steps.<
replacements.to: >因此，坐在同一张工作台前的两位客人，不一定会做完全相同的操作。<

replacements.from: >You are not expected to arrive knowing<
>how and why the technique is used<
replacements.to: >这项技法如何使用，以及为什么使用<

replacements.from: >Once the main shape is established, the piece still needs refinement.<
replacements.to: >主要形状完成后，作品仍需要细化。<

replacements.from: >Filing can remove rough or uneven areas, refine edges, and help bring the form closer to the intended design.<

replacements.from: >Make Your Own Silver Ring in Bali:<

replacements.to: >在巴厘岛买一枚银戒指很容易。<

replacements.from: >If you have never made jewelry before, you might wonder how much of it you can realistically do yourself.<
replacements.to: >如果从没做过首饰，你可能想知道，究竟有多少步骤可以自己完成。<

replacements.from: >Here is what to expect when you make your own silver ring at Bali Jewelry Masterclass.<

replacements.from: >Start with the ring you want to make<

replacements.to: >拿起工具前，需要先有个方向。<

replacements.to: >导师会帮你结合可用材料、课程时间和所涉及的技法，评估实际能完成什么。<

replacements.from: >This is also the time to discuss details that may affect the amount of silver, difficulty, or additional work required.<

replacements.to: >课程中很有意思的一部分，是看到材料要经历多少变化，才会有首饰的样子。<

replacements.from: >The silver still needs to be developed to the right dimensions and gradually formed into the ring you chose to make.<
replacements.to: >银材仍需要加工至合适尺寸，再逐渐成形为你选定的戒指。<

replacements.from: >So when you first sit down at the bench, you are not simply decorating or polishing a ring that already exists.<

ring-finishes-explained.html.sourceTitle: Ring Finishes Explained: Polished, Matte, Hammered & Organic Textures | BJM
ring-finishes-explained.html.sourceDescription: Explore polished, matte, hammered and organic ring finishes, and learn how texture and surface treatment can change the character of a silver ring.
ring-finishes-explained.html.title: 戒指表面效果详解：抛光、哑光、锤纹与自然纹理 | BJM
ring-finishes-explained.html.description: 了解抛光、哑光、锤纹与自然感的戒指表面效果，以及纹理和表面处理如何改变银戒指的个性。

replacements.from: >Two silver rings can have the same basic shape and still look completely different.<
replacements.to: >两枚银戒指，即使基本形状相同，外观也可能截然不同。<

replacements.from: >One might have a bright, reflective surface. Another might appear softer and more understated. A third might catch the light across hundreds of small hammer marks.<
replacements.to: >一枚可能明亮如镜，另一枚柔和低调，还有一枚的细密锤痕会从不同角度反射光线。<

replacements.from: >The difference is often not the ring itself, but what happens at its surface.<
replacements.to: >区别往往不在戒指本身，而在于它的表面处理。<

replacements.from: >When you make a ring of your own, choosing that surface is part of choosing how you want the finished piece to look and feel.<
replacements.to: >亲手制作戒指时，选择表面效果，也是决定成品外观与质感的一部分。<

replacements.from: >Here are four directions you can consider.<
replacements.to: >以下四种方向，可以作为你的参考。<

replacements.from: >A polished finish creates a smooth surface that reflects light clearly.<
replacements.to: >抛光会形成光滑的表面，让光线清晰地反射。<

replacements.from: >It is probably what many people first picture when they imagine finished silver jewelry: clean, bright, and reflective.<
replacements.to: >很多人想到银饰成品时，首先浮现的可能就是这种干净、明亮、有光泽的效果。<

replacements.from: >On a simple band, polishing can emphasize the shape of the ring because there is very little texture competing for attention.<
replacements.to: >对于简单的戒圈，抛光可以突出戒指的形状，因为表面没有太多纹理分散注意力。<

replacements.from: >It can also make small surface marks easier to notice over time. That is normal for jewelry that is worn and handled regularly.<
replacements.to: >它也可能让日后出现的细小表面痕迹更加明显。首饰经常佩戴、接触其他物品，出现这些痕迹很正常。<

replacements.from: >A polished surface is not more complete or better made than other finishes.<
replacements.to: >抛光表面并不意味着作品更完整，或做得更好。<

replacements.from: >It is simply one way of treating the surface.<
replacements.to: >它只是表面处理的一种方式。<

replacements.from: >A matte finish reduces strong reflections and gives the surface a softer appearance.<
replacements.to: >哑光处理会减少强烈反光，让表面看起来更柔和。<

replacements.from: >The effect can make a simple ring feel noticeably different without changing its basic shape or proportions.<
replacements.to: >无需改变基本形状或比例，这种效果就能让一枚简单的戒指呈现明显不同的感觉。<

replacements.from: >Where polished silver catches light sharply, matte silver scatters it more gently.<
replacements.to: >抛光银面会清晰地反射光线，而哑光银面则让光线更柔和地散开。<

replacements.from: >That makes matte a useful choice if you prefer a quieter, less reflective look.<
replacements.to: >如果你喜欢低调、不太反光的外观，哑光值得考虑。<

replacements.from: >Like any surface treatment, its appearance can change with wear. Areas that regularly rub against skin, clothing, or other objects may gradually develop a different sheen.<
replacements.to: >和其他表面处理一样，哑光的外观也会随着佩戴而变化。经常与皮肤、衣物或其他物体摩擦的部位，可能逐渐产生不同的光泽。<

replacements.from: >That change is part of what happens when jewelry is worn rather than kept untouched.<
replacements.to: >这也是首饰被日常佩戴，而非一直原样存放时，会发生的变化。<
>锤纹：让工具留下的痕迹成为设计<

replacements.from: >A hammered texture does almost the opposite of trying to hide how the surface was worked.<
replacements.to: >锤纹几乎与隐藏表面加工痕迹的做法相反。<

replacements.from: >The hammer marks become part of the design.<
replacements.to: >锤击留下的痕迹，本身就是设计的一部分。<

replacements.from: >Repeated strikes create small changes in the surface<
replacements.to: >反复锤击会让表面产生细微变化<

replacements.from: >, producing facets and impressions that catch light at different angles.<
replacements.to: >，形成从不同角度反射光线的切面与凹痕。<

replacements.from: >The size, placement, and pattern of those marks can change the effect considerably. Hammering does not have to produce one standard appearance.<
replacements.to: >痕迹的大小、位置和排列方式，会明显影响效果。锤纹并不只有一种固定的外观。<

replacements.from: >There is also an important distinction between <
>A hammered ring can still have a relatively bright finish. Another can have the same type of texture with a softer, less reflective surface.<
replacements.to: >锤纹戒指依然可以有较明亮的表面。另一枚也可以拥有相同类型的纹理，却呈现柔和、不太反光的效果。<

replacements.from: >Hammering describes what is happening physically to the surface.<
replacements.to: >锤纹描述的是表面在形态上发生的变化。<

replacements.from: >The final finish determines how that textured surface is presented.<
replacements.to: >最终的表面处理，则决定这种纹理如何呈现。<

replacements.from: >“Organic” works a little differently from polished, matte, or hammered.<
replacements.to: >“自然感”与抛光、哑光或锤纹略有不同。<

replacements.from: >It is better understood as a design direction than as one specific finishing technique.<
replacements.to: >它更适合被理解为一种设计方向，而非某一种特定的表面处理技法。<

replacements.from: >An organic ring might have a subtly irregular contour, asymmetry, uneven-looking texture, or variations that make the piece feel less mechanically uniform.<
replacements.to: >带有自然感的戒指，可能有略微不规则的轮廓、不对称的造型、看似不均匀的纹理，或让作品不那么像机械加工的细微变化。<

replacements.from: >An organic appearance does not mean that every accidental mark becomes part of the design or that refinement no longer matters.<
replacements.to: >自然感并不意味着每一道意外留下的痕迹都要成为设计，也不意味着无需再修整。<

replacements.from: >The irregularity is kept or created because it contributes to the character of the piece.<
replacements.to: >保留或创造这些不规则，是因为它们能体现作品的个性。<

replacements.from: >That distinction separates deliberate variation from something that is simply unfinished.<
replacements.to: >这也区分了有意安排的变化，与单纯尚未完成的状态。<

replacements.from: >Texture and finish are not the same thing<
replacements.to: >纹理与表面处理不是一回事<

replacements.from: >These terms are easy to mix together, but separating them gives you more freedom when thinking about a design.<
replacements.to: >这些词容易混在一起，但区分它们，能让你在构思设计时拥有更多选择。<

replacements.from: > describes the physical character of the surface: smooth, hammered, irregular, patterned, or otherwise worked.<
replacements.to: > 描述的是表面的形态特征：光滑、带锤纹、不规则、有图案，或经过其他加工。<

replacements.from: > describes how that surface is treated and how it ultimately appears.<
replacements.to: > 描述的是如何处理这个表面，以及它最终呈现的效果。<
>因此，这些选择可以相互结合。<

replacements.from: >A smooth ring can be polished or matte.<
replacements.to: >光滑的戒指可以做成抛光或哑光。<

replacements.from: >A hammered ring can be bright or subdued.<
replacements.to: >有锤纹的戒指可以明亮，也可以低调柔和。<

replacements.from: >An organic form can be combined with different textures and surface treatments.<
replacements.to: >自然感的造型，也能结合不同纹理与表面处理。<

replacements.from: >You are not necessarily choosing between four rigid boxes.<
replacements.to: >你不一定是在四个互不相容的类别之间做选择。<

replacements.from: >You are deciding how several visual characteristics should work together.<
replacements.to: >而是在决定几种视觉特征如何搭配。<

replacements.from: >How much difference can the surface really make?<
>Imagine four rings with approximately the same width and proportions.<
replacements.to: >想象四枚宽度和比例大致相同的戒指。<

replacements.from: >Give the first a smooth, polished surface and it can feel clean and bright.<
replacements.to: >第一枚采用光滑的抛光表面，会显得干净、明亮。<

replacements.from: >Give the second a matte finish and the same basic form becomes quieter and less reflective.<
replacements.to: >第二枚采用哑光处理，同样的基本造型就会更低调，反光更柔和。<

replacements.from: >Add hammer texture to the third and light begins breaking across the individual marks.<
replacements.to: >第三枚加上锤纹，光线开始在一道道痕迹之间折射变化。<

replacements.from: >Allow the fourth to keep a deliberately irregular contour and its silhouette changes as well as its surface character.<
replacements.to: >第四枚有意保留不规则轮廓，不仅表面特征变了，整体外形也会不同。<

replacements.from: >The way you treat it changes what your eye notices first.<
replacements.to: >处理方式会改变你第一眼注意到的细节。<

replacements.from: >That is why a ring does not need complicated decoration to feel distinctive.<
replacements.to: >所以，戒指不需要复杂装饰，也能有自己的特色。<

replacements.from: >What happens to a finish when you wear the ring?<
replacements.to: >佩戴之后，表面效果会怎样变化？<
>没有任何表面能永远完全不受接触影响。<

replacements.from: >Rings regularly come into contact with skin, clothing, tables, bags, tools, and countless other surfaces. Over time, that contact can leave small scratches or alter the way a finish looks.<
replacements.to: >戒指经常接触皮肤、衣物、桌面、包、工具，以及无数其他表面。随着时间推移，这些接触可能留下细小划痕，或改变表面效果。<

replacements.from: >On polished jewelry, fine marks can interrupt the reflective surface.<
replacements.to: >对于抛光首饰，细微痕迹可能打断原本连续的反光。<

replacements.from: >Matte finishes may become smoother or shinier in areas that receive repeated friction.<
replacements.to: >哑光表面在反复摩擦的部位，可能变得更光滑或更有光泽。<

replacements.from: >Textured surfaces can also change gradually with wear.<
replacements.to: >有纹理的表面，也可能随着佩戴逐渐变化。<

replacements.from: >This does not necessarily mean something has gone wrong with the jewelry.<
replacements.to: >这不一定意味着首饰出了问题。<

replacements.from: >It is simply worth remembering that the finish you choose on the day the ring is made is the beginning of the surface's life, not a guarantee that it will remain visually identical forever.<
replacements.to: >只需记得，制作当天选定的表面效果，是这件作品表面变化的起点，而不是保证它永远保持完全相同外观的承诺。<

replacements.from: >Start with what you actually like rather than what you think a silver ring is supposed to look like.<
replacements.to: >先从自己真正喜欢的效果出发，而不是想象银戒指“应该”是什么样。<

replacements.from: >If you enjoy bright, clean surfaces, polished may be the obvious direction.<
replacements.to: >如果你喜欢明亮、干净的表面，抛光可能很适合。<

replacements.from: >If you prefer something softer and less reflective, consider matte.<
replacements.to: >如果你偏爱柔和、不太反光的效果，可以考虑哑光。<

replacements.from: >If you want the tools to leave a visible pattern, hammered texture gives those marks a deliberate role in the design.<
replacements.to: >如果希望工具留下可见的图案，锤纹能让这些痕迹有意成为设计的一部分。<

replacements.from: >If perfect uniformity is not what attracts you, an organic direction may suit the piece better.<
replacements.to: >如果吸引你的不是完全整齐一致的效果，自然感的方向可能更适合这件作品。<

replacements.from: >A hammered texture does not prevent you from choosing how bright or subdued the final surface should be. An organic form does not dictate one particular finish.<

replacements.from: >The better question is not simply, “Which category do I choose?”<
replacements.to: >更值得问的，不只是“我该选哪一类？”<

replacements.to: >而是“看到、戴上这枚戒指时，我希望它给我什么感觉？”<

silver-jewelry-making-techniques.html.sourceTitle: Silver Jewelry Making Techniques: Melting, Rolling, Hammering, Soldering & Polishing | BJM
silver-jewelry-making-techniques.html.sourceDescription: Explore four fundamental silver jewelry making techniques—cutting, hammering, soldering and polishing—and how each helps transform metal into jewelry.
silver-jewelry-making-techniques.html.title: 银饰制作技法：熔银、压延、锤打、焊接与抛光 | BJM
silver-jewelry-making-techniques.html.description: 了解切割、锤打、焊接与抛光这四种基础银饰制作技法，以及它们如何帮助金属成为首饰。

replacements.from: >A piece of silver can change dramatically before it becomes jewelry.<
replacements.to: >一块银材在成为首饰之前，可能经历很大的变化。<

replacements.from: >It can move from solid to liquid, cool into a completely new form, become longer and thinner under pressure, take shape under a hammer, be joined with heat, and finally be refined into a surface that looks and feels finished.<
replacements.to: >它会从固体变成液体，冷却后形成全新的形态，在压力下变得更长、更薄，在锤击下成形，通过加热连接，最后经过修整，呈现成品应有的外观与手感。<

replacements.from: >Each of those changes comes from a different jewelry-making technique.<
replacements.to: >每一种变化，都来自不同的首饰制作技法。<

replacements.from: >At Bali Jewelry Masterclass, the exact techniques you encounter depend on the piece you choose to make. You do not need to know any of them before you arrive, but understanding what each one does makes the process much easier to appreciate.<
replacements.to: >在 Bali Jewelry Masterclass，你会接触哪些技法，取决于所选的作品。来之前不需要掌握它们，但了解每种技法的作用，会让你更容易理解整个过程。<

replacements.from: >Here are some of the main techniques you may see and use at the workbench.<
replacements.to: >以下是你可能在工作台前看到、亲自使用的几种主要技法。<

replacements.from: >Melting is one of the most dramatic transformations in the process.<
replacements.to: >熔银是整个过程中变化最明显的环节之一。<

replacements.from: >Silver is heated beyond its melting point until the solid metal becomes liquid.<
replacements.to: >将银加热至超过熔点，固态金属就会变成液体。<

replacements.from: >the molten silver can then be poured into an ingot mold<
replacements.to: >熔化的银随后可以倒入银锭模具<

replacements.from: >. As it cools, it solidifies into a compact form that can be worked further.<
replacements.to: >。冷却后，它会凝固成紧实的形态，供后续加工。<

replacements.from: >The mold does not create the finished jewelry. It simply gives the silver a workable starting form for the stages that follow.<
replacements.to: >模具并不会直接做出首饰成品，只是让银材有一个适合后续加工的起始形态。<

replacements.from: >Because melting involves extremely high temperatures, this is a stage where your instructor stays closely involved and steps in whenever necessary.<
replacements.to: >熔银涉及极高温度，因此在这个环节，导师会密切参与，并在需要时接手协助。<

replacements.from: >The interesting part is what comes next.<
>The silver may be solid again, but it is still a long way from becoming jewelry.<
replacements.to: >银虽然重新变成了固体，但距离成为首饰还需要不少步骤。<

replacements.from: >Once the silver has solidified, its dimensions need to be developed for the chosen design.<
replacements.to: >银凝固后，需要根据所选设计，逐步调整它的尺寸。<

replacements.from: >A rolling mill passes the metal between rollers under pressure, gradually reducing and reshaping it.<
replacements.to: >压片机让金属在压力下通过轧辊，逐渐减薄、改变形状。<

replacements.from: >This does not usually happen in one dramatic pass. The dimensions are developed progressively and checked along the way.<
replacements.to: >通常不是一次压过就能完成，而是逐步调整尺寸，并在过程中不断检查。<

replacements.from: >If more adjustment is required, the silver may be heated and worked again before further rolling.<
replacements.to: >如果还需要调整，银材可能会先加热、再加工，然后继续压延。<

replacements.from: >To a beginner, a rolling mill can look like a fairly simple machine.<
replacements.to: >对初学者来说，压片机看起来可能只是台比较简单的机器。<

replacements.from: >What matters is the control it gives the maker.<
replacements.to: >重要的是，它能帮助制作者控制材料。<

replacements.from: >Small changes in thickness and dimensions can determine whether the material is ready for the shape you are trying to create.<
replacements.to: >厚度和尺寸上的细微变化，会决定材料是否适合接下来要做的造型。<

replacements.from: >A jewelry hammer can do more than leave decorative marks.<
replacements.to: >首饰锤的作用，不只是留下装饰性的痕迹。<

replacements.from: >Hammering can help develop the form of the metal, make adjustments during shaping, or deliberately create texture on the finished surface.<
replacements.to: >锤打可以帮助金属成形、在塑形过程中进行调整，也可以有意在成品表面制作纹理。<

replacements.from: >That is why hammer marks are not always imperfections that need to disappear.<
replacements.to: >因此，锤痕并不总是需要消除的瑕疵。<

replacements.from: >Sometimes they are part of the design.<
replacements.to: >有时，它们就是设计的一部分。<

replacements.from: >The pattern, direction, and placement of the marks affect how the surface catches light and how the finished piece looks.<
replacements.to: >痕迹的排列、方向与位置，会影响表面如何反射光线，以及成品的外观。<

replacements.from: >A smooth band and a hammered band may begin with similar material but end up with very different character.<

how-a-silver-ring-is-made.html.description: 了解手工银戒指如何经过设计、成形、焊接、制作纹理、修整与抛光，逐步完成。

replacements.from: >A finished silver ring can look surprisingly simple.<
replacements.to: >一枚银戒指成品，看起来可能很简单。<

replacements.from: >What you do not see is everything that happened before it reached that point: measuring the material, melting it, forming it into workable dimensions, shaping the ring, refining the surface, and finishing the piece.<
replacements.to: >但你看不到它完成之前经历的过程：计量材料、熔银、加工成适合制作的尺寸、塑造戒指、修整表面，再完成最后的处理。<

replacements.from: >There is no single method used to make every silver ring. Different designs and production methods require different processes.<
replacements.to: >并不是每枚银戒指都用同一种方法制作。不同的设计与生产方式，需要不同的过程。<

replacements.from: >At Bali Jewelry Masterclass, the process we use for many of our workshop pieces begins with silver itself. Instead of starting with a finished ring blank, you get to see the material change from one stage to the next.<
replacements.to: >在 Bali Jewelry Masterclass，我们许多课程作品的制作从银材本身开始。不是直接使用现成的戒指坯，而是让你看到材料在每个阶段如何变化。<

replacements.from: >The process begins before any silver is melted.<
replacements.to: >在熔银之前，制作过程就已经开始了。<

replacements.from: >First, you choose the ring you want to make. The design helps determine the dimensions, shape, texture, and amount of silver required.<
replacements.to: >首先，选择你想制作的戒指。设计会帮助确定所需的尺寸、形状、纹理与银材用量。<

replacements.from: >A narrow band and a heavier ring, for example, do not need exactly the same amount of material or the same dimensions.<
replacements.to: >例如，窄戒圈与较重的戒指，需要的材料用量与尺寸就不完全相同。<

replacements.from: >Your instructor will help you choose a design that can realistically be completed with the available material, workshop time, and techniques involved.<
replacements.to: >导师会帮你选择一种能在可用材料、课程时间与相关技法范围内实际完成的设计。<

replacements.from: >Once the design is clear, the material can be prepared.<
replacements.to: >设计明确后，就可以准备材料。<

replacements.from: >The silver is weighed according to the amount needed for the chosen ring.<
replacements.to: >根据所选戒指的需要，称量银材。<

replacements.from: >At BJM, we use a jewelry scale to measure the material before the making process begins.<
replacements.to: >在 BJM，我们会在开始制作前，使用首饰秤计量材料。<

replacements.from: >Your ring size is also checked so the dimensions can be considered as the silver is formed and shaped.<
replacements.to: >也会确认你的戒指尺寸，以便在加工、塑形时考虑所需尺寸。<

replacements.from: >These measurements give the process a starting point. They can be checked again later because the material will change considerably before it becomes a ring.<
replacements.to: >这些测量为制作提供起点。之后也可以再次检查，因为材料在成为戒指前会发生很大变化。<

replacements.from: >Next comes one of the biggest physical changes in the entire process.<
replacements.to: >接下来，是整个过程中最明显的物理变化之一。<

replacements.from: >The solid silver is heated until it melts.<
>This is not simply warming the metal to make it easier to bend. The silver changes from solid metal into molten silver.<
replacements.to: >这不只是把金属加热，让它更容易弯曲，而是让银从固态金属变成熔融的银液。<

replacements.from: >Once fully molten, it is ready for the next stage.<
replacements.to: >完全熔化后，就可以进入下一步。<

replacements.from: >Because this process involves very high heat, your instructor stays closely involved and steps in whenever necessary.<
replacements.to: >这个过程涉及极高温度，导师会密切参与，并在需要时接手协助。<

replacements.from: >4. Pour the molten silver into an ingot mold<
>The molten silver is poured into an ingot mold.<

replacements.to: >银在模具中冷却、重新凝固，形成紧实的银条，供后续加工。<

replacements.from: >This is different from casting a finished ring in a ring-shaped mold. The ingot is only an intermediate form.<

replacements.from: >The solidified silver now needs to be brought closer to the dimensions required for the ring.<
